collectionPages.title: Programming Prints & Developer Gifts
collectionPages.description: Explore coding jokes, debugging graphics and developer designs. Compare prints and find a gift for a programmer, software engineer or database enthusiast.
collectionPages.intro: Pick a coding, database or debugging joke for someone who writes software. Preview each design before choosing a product on the marketplace.
collectionPages.heading: Programming Prints

collectionPages.title: Photography & Videography Prints
collectionPages.description: Browse camera, lens and filmmaking graphics for photographers and video creators. Find a photography print that matches their favorite hobby or everyday work.
collectionPages.intro: Choose camera and lens artwork for a photography enthusiast, or a filmmaking reference for a video creator. Open a design to preview it and check available products.
collectionPages.heading: Photography Prints

collectionPages.title: Food Prints & Gifts for Food Lovers
collectionPages.description: Discover ramen, coffee, chili and other food-themed designs. Browse playful culinary artwork and find a print for a foodie, home cook or coffee lover.
collectionPages.intro: Choose by their favorite flavor: ramen and noodles, coffee or spicy food. Open a print to compare its artwork and check available products on the marketplace.
collectionPages.heading: Food Prints

collectionPages.title: Cat & Dog Prints for Pet Lovers
collectionPages.description: Find cat, dog and bunny artwork for animal lovers, including playful pet humor and coding cats. Compare prints and choose a design for a pet-loving friend.
collectionPages.intro: Choose cat, dog or bunny artwork, from playful pet humor to coding cats. Open a print to compare its artwork and available products on the marketplace.
collectionPages.heading: Pet Prints

collectionPages.title: Open Source Prints & Gifts
collectionPages.description: Explore prints about open source, contributors, maintainers and collaboration. Find a design that celebrates shared code and the people who build it.
collectionPages.intro: Find a contributor, maintainer or collaboration motif for someone who enjoys shared code. Preview a design before choosing its products on the marketplace.
collectionPages.heading: Open Source Prints
